comment: Independent C-first human Priest with msg_window:single. #name names the starting mace with a getlin answer holding the bytes 0xC9 and 0xEA, and dropping it prints a message that holds them. Each Ctrl-P reaches topl.c redotoplin(), which prints the line through putsyms() and topl_putsym(char); recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores a high byte as a negative char, so its cell keeps what was there (steps 19 and 21: the drop message, then the getlin prompt and answer that hooked_tty_getlin() left in the history). 's' then flushes the map before a last Ctrl-P.
